text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for gathering here, everyone! Let's 
do one more song!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Gathered Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Wait, isn't that Silence Suzuka? She 
really is such a pretty girl!

text_block_list.name: Gathered Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
But why is Suzuka-chan performing a live? 
A Winning Live would be one thing, but...

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, they're doing something 
interesting over there! We have time, so 
let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...I'll pass. A live performance is meant 
for star Umamusume anyway.

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Even watching will only make us realize 
it. The gap between them and us, who can't 
win races—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's not true!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is my request to everyone! Let's do a 
live performance together to express our 
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Lives are something us Umamusume really 
look up to, right? When you think of a 
live, the first thing that comes to mind 
is the Winning Live, after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's a stage you can only earn through 
serious competition. That's why it shines 
so brightly... and why we dream of it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, even the girls who didn't get 
center stage train relentlessly every 
single day, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone works hard every day on singing, 
dancing, and training, all so they can 
show it off in front of the fans one day.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco totally supports the Winning Live 
system! Part of why I looked up to lives 
so much is because of it!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I think it's wonderful to have a 
live event once a year at the end of the 
year, where anyone can thank their fans 
through song and dance!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So why don't we all convey our feelings 
with everything we've got? To the fans, 
directly! In nobody else's voice but our 
own!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We'll sing with all our hearts too! 
Pouring in our wish for your support.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So won't you revive the Grand Live 
together with Falco and the others?

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, why don't we stop by the stage 
after all? I think... I might want to sing 
together with you."

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Just kidding, haha! Ah, hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ………… ……Just a little bit, okay?

text_block_list.name: Passerby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
…………Error encountered. Because of their 
song again……
